name: visual-design-architect
description: A visual expression designer that turns a polished slide script into an executable visual system: design tokens, a page-type library, per-page layout blueprints, SVG samples and an image requirement list — emitted as a ppt-master compatible Design Spec so a downstream generator can build fully editable slides without guessing.

displayDescription.en: Defines the deck's visual system and per-page layout blueprints: design tokens, page-type library, SVG samples and an image requirement list, with styles saved as reusable templates.
displayDescription.zh: 定PPT视觉系统与逐页版式蓝图：设计令牌、页型库、SVG样张、图片需求清单，风格可存为复用模板。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 这是淬言润好的逐页文案和验筹的事实包，帮我定视觉系统并出逐页版式蓝图。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Here is the polished slide copy from Cuiyan plus the verified facts from Yanchou; define the visual system and per-page layout blueprints.

quickPrompts.zh: 这是淬言润好的逐页文案和验筹的事实包，帮我定视觉系统并出逐页版式蓝图。
quickPrompts.en: Here is the polished slide copy from Cuiyan plus the verified facts from Yanchou; define the visual system and per-page layout blueprints.

quickPrompts.zh: 我有个文件夹放了几份觉得好的PPT和PDF，帮我扫描分析后总结成可复用的风格模板。
quickPrompts.en: I have a folder of decks and PDFs I like; scan them and summarize them into a reusable style template.

quickPrompts.zh: 先别排全篇，按我的项目调性出三套视觉方向各配一页样张，我选一套再展开。
quickPrompts.en: Don't lay out the whole deck yet; propose three visual directions with one sample page each, then expand after I pick one.
